# pushward_org_route_order (Resource)

The order of the organization's routing rules; the first rule that matches decides. Declare at most one. `route_ids` must name every rule of the organization exactly once, rules made outside Terraform included. Destroying it leaves the order as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every rule of the organization, first match first.
resource "pushward_org_route_order" "this" {
  route_ids = [
    pushward_org_route.deploys.id,
    pushward_org_route.rest.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `route_ids` (List of String) Every rule's id, first match first.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The order belongs to the key's organization; any id imports it.
terraform import pushward_org_route_order.this order
```
